records.title: Orbisk
records.description: Orbisk is a fully automated food waste monitor for professional kitchens that uses a camera and an artificial intelligence (AI)-based image recognition model to recognize and measure what kind of food is thrown away, in what quantities and at what time of the day. The collected data can be accessed from a personalized dashboard, allowing the user to optimize their operations, sourcing and purchasing.
records.abstract: Fully automated food waste monitor for professional kitchens

_annotations.Impact: Orbisk can help address inefficiencies in catering operations by balancing portions, optimizing stocks and increasing planning efficiency. According to the Orbisk website, food waste is reduced by up to 70 percent, resulting in significant savings in material purchases, labour costs and waste that can amount to EUR 20 000–60 000 per annum for an average restaurant, a net margin improvement of up to 4 percent and annual savings of over 4000 kg in food waste, while also preventing the emission of 15 t of CO2 and 14 million l of water use.

records.title: FoodFix
records.description: NutriFix is a decision support system for medical operatives & dieticians operating in institutional settings, and is designed to streamline the entire process of nutritional care for in-patients, from the creation of personalized dynamic nutrition profiles, to the provision of monitoring and alert functions. Healthcare providers can improve patient outcomes, reduce costs and enhance the overall quality of care. The solution facilitates the real-time monitoring of the nutritional status of patients, thus preventing malnutrition, while also tracking unconsumed food, supporting accurate food supply and reducing waste. The available analytics include changes in food consumption, actual consumption gaps in the composition of the essential nutritional values, food portions rejected by the patient and recommendations for nutritional interventions by the nutritionist, nutrition and composition balance analyses of menus, etc.
records.abstract: Digital health solution for optimal in-patient nutritional care

_annotations.Source: Information provided by a member of the organization
_annotations.Impact: The solution aims to facilitate the efficient and effective monitoring and control of each patient, and to reduce medical complications, mortality, hospitalization days and re-hospitalizations. For hospitals, it supports the minimization of risks, food waste and extra care expenses, and it provides the medical team with active warnings, detailed reports on nutrient intake, insights into the effects of healing actions, and evidence of allergens, enhancing overall patient care and operational efficiency.

It facilitates precise land control, allows the application of corrective measures and optimizes resource use. LAYERS is a tool that harmonizes land efficiency, resource conservation, and crop health, aligning with modern agricultural demands in support of greater yields and responsible stewardship.

_annotations.Impact: LAYERS can deliver pivotal insights into production practices, and uses forecasting models that stand out as game-changers for producers. Agriculturalists can gain visibility into expected tonnage and content peaks, allowing precise harvest date planning in support of remarkable 10% production increases (according to the company). Targeted input utilization can minimize waste, providing significant cost savings, while continuous crop monitoring provides agriculturalists with real-time data, facilitating timely interventions that can be used to support transitions to sustainable practices.

records.title: NAITS
records.description: Georgia’s National Animal Identification and Traceability System (NAITS) is a comprehensive animal health and food safety platform for the collection and recording of mandatory information on animals, their keepers and their locations all over Georgia. It connects approximately 1000 users across state institutions and other actors along the value chain (e.g., vets, inspectors, farmers). NAITS was first launched in the country in 2012 and handed over to the Government in 2021. The system covers all mandatory identifiable species in the country (ruminants, pigs, equids and bees), as well as other relevant animal holdings (poultry and aquaculture establishments), and stores data, for example, on over 1 million registered bovines, including birth and origin data, vaccination status, health and slaughter conditions. NAITS is also used for the electronic recording, storage and analysis of data on non-food animals (pets and strays) by municipal or regional Animal Management Agencies, and can be used to improve the population management of stray dogs and cats in Georgia. NAITS is fully compliant with the requirements of the EU Animal Health Law (EU Regulation 429/2016), and it is the key tool supporting the protection and development of the livestock sector in Georgia.
records.abstract: Georgia’s National Animal Identification and Traceability System

_annotations.Source: Information provided by a member of the organization
_annotations.Impact: NAITS provides significant savings in time and effort in the collection and storage of data, and targets the full replacement of the paper forms traditionally used in Georgia. The system facilitates the tracking of animals and animal-origin products in a prompt and timely manner, and is an important part of the complex food safety chain. It ensures the delivery of safe food to consumers and has improved the overall food system in Georgia, facilitating trade and contributing to the effective implementation of the Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area (DCFTA) agreement. As of January 2024, some 1 million users were registered on the system (veterinarians and inspectors), as well as more than 250 000 animal holdings, and the data of more than 1 million bovines was being held.

records.title: Agrikolis
records.description: AgriKolis is an online platform connecting farmers and logistic operators to facilitate the rental farm space in support of delivery operations. Farmers can register their available space on the online platform for rental to logistic operators looking to establish storage or collection points in remote rural areas. The platform thus generates new revenue sources for farmers through the rental of their unutilized farm space, while logistic operators can increase their options for the distribution and storage of goods.
records.abstract: Platform for farm space rentals

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The platform’s website reports that 305 farms are currently registered as landing spaces in the AgriKolis network, and that 640 000 packages have been dealt with through the platform, while 1000 clients are served each day. Numerous testimonials on the website state that the platform provides an additional revenue stream that does not place a major additional load on farmers.

records.title: Agro Scout
records.description: AgroScout offers AI-driven crop monitoring solutions through the utilization of drones and remote sensing technologies for the detection of diseases, pests and nutrient deficiencies. Its key features include real-time crop monitoring, pest and disease diagnoses for crops, carbon in-setting, orthophoto generation and predictive analytics.
records.abstract: Platform for monitoring crop development in real-time

_annotations.Source: Information provided by a member of the organization
_annotations.Impact: The potential benefits of AgroScout include improved crop health, yield optimization and cost reduction. The early detection of crop issues supports timely interventions, reducing yield losses and enhancing profitability. Further benefits include increased food security, sustainable agriculture practices and enhanced competitiveness for farmers. AgroScout has amassed over 2.4 million images of 20 different crops, and over 145 000 acres in 20 countries had been analysed by May 2024, according to the company website.

records.title: Agrogate (აგროგატი)
records.description: Agrogate is an agritourism online platform in the South Caucasus, uniting over 100 facilities from Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan. Spearheaded by the Georgian Farmers' Association and partners, it connects travelers with traditional agricultural experiences. Its features include accommodation booking and masterclass reservations.
records.abstract: Agritourism platform

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The Agrogate solution, a pioneering agritourism platform in the South Caucasus, has positively impacted over 100 registered facilities in Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan, according to various news outlets. Through collaboration supported by the USAID EDGE project, it fosters regional cooperation and cross-country partnerships. The platform's launch in 2021 provides travelers with easy access to agritourism sites, promoting economic growth for participating enterprises. Training initiatives in gastronomy, marketing, and safety have enhanced skills for 180 representatives, improving services for visitors. Individual success stories, like Sheki Friends Guest House and Machanents House, highlight increased visibility and revenue. "Agro Stop" promotional videos contribute to rural development and increased tourism. The digital platform's unique features facilitate direct communication between smallholder farmers and customers. By elevating agriculture, education, and local economies, Agrogate aligns with sustainable development goals.

records.title: Trusty
records.description: Trusty is a digital traceability platform for helping producers and retailers with sharing agri-food products' journeys and their safety and sustainability standards with the final consumers. QR codes on product packages provide detailed insights into production processes, facilities and stakeholders within the supply chain. This solution enhances communication, enabling farmers to share stories, certifications, and analyses, cultivating a direct connection with consumers. Trusty effectively addresses challenges related to market access and supply chain transparency, delivering benefits like heightened sales, brand recognition, and enhanced sustainability.

Erüst Agriculture, facing market challenges, swiftly implemented Trusty to enhance food transparency, retain customer loyalty, and achieved over 5 percent boost in overall sales within two months.

records.title: TazeDirekt
records.description: TazeDirekt is an e-commerce platform focusing on selling and delivering selected fresh, organic, and regional products of the highest quality in Türkiye. It operates with a commitment to connecting consumers with local producers and organic farms that align with their principles. The platform meticulously selects products without intermediaries, ensuring a controlled and transparent supply chain. Pesticide-analyzed fruits and vegetables from organic farms are chosen within 24 hours of harvest, and final checks are conducted before careful packaging. The platform prioritizes quality, conducting thorough examinations and offering only products that meet stringent standards. records.title: Toros Farmer Application
records.description: Toros Farmer Application is an agricultural decision support application that supports farmers with a list of fertilizers to use based on specific data and information provided by the user on geolocation, soil and crop. The App can be downloaded for free on smartphones, personal computers, and tablets and provides specific fertilization suggestions to farmers based on the coordinates of the field and instantaneous weather, soil and plant conditions, thus aiming to increase savings and productivity. Farmers that upload their information to the system receive advance warnings for frost, storm and excessive rain risks for their own fields through machine learning, while also obtaining important agricultural information concerning rainfall and temperature/heat accumulation.

records.description: The Agriculture and Forestry Academy is an online platform for education and knowledge sharing launched by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry of Türkiye. The platform provides farmers with up-to-date, sustainable knowledge through online resources, live broadcasting, and a Digital Agriculture Library. records.title: TARGIS-VRA
records.description: TARGIS-VAR, which stands for Variable Rate Application Fertilization System, is a system for optimizing the mechanical spreading of fertilisers. It aims to save fertilizer use, raise productivity, minimize nitrate pollution, sustain ecological balance and hence to improve the sustainability of agricultural activities. Developed by the R&D support of Ministry of Agriculture – “General Directorate of Agricultural Research and Polices” (TAGEM) - TARGIS-VRA develops fertilization maps to allow the determination of optimum fertilization needs according to the specific conditions and needs of the land and the weather conditions. The maps are used to implement Internet of Things’ applications to control the fertilization operations.
records.abstract: Variable Rate Application Fertilization System integrable into existing machines and tractors
records.owner_name: Geosys Geographic Information Systems Ltd. Co

_annotations.Impact: The company’s website reports that up to 24 percent of fertilizer savings can be achieved in agricultural production through these technologies for variable rate applications. Among other positive outcomes reported by the organisation are the minimization of the use of fertilizer, minimization of nitrate pollution, optimization of spraying and fertilizing operations by its capacity to change VRA application settings automatically according to the weather conditions which are affecting the quality and the efficiency of the operations.

records.title: Tarfin
records.description: Tarfin is an online marketplace and mobile app for farmers to purchase feed, seeds, fertilizer, and equipment, with the option to pay them after the harvest. The platform offers farmers access to bank credit for purchasing agricultural inputs, providing the chance to pay at harvest. Tarfin allows farmers to find the closest partner stores and collection points that offer the necessary inputs, compare prices and instantly apply for financing. The farmers can then head to the physical store, sign a promissory note and walk away with the products.
records.abstract: Marketplace with agricultural inputs

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The comparability of agri-input prices and features enable the reduction of information asymmetries among market actors, such as farmers, retailers, and producers of agri-inputs. Competitive input prices and flexible payment terms could allow the farmers to pay at harvest and potentially ease financial burdens. Tarfin's extended payment options and the absence of collateral requirements enhance accessibility for a broader range of agricultural producers. With a vast retailer network in Turkey and Romania, farmers can benefit from a wide selection of inputs, possibly enhancing their choices and overall agricultural productivity.

records.title: Supercam UAV
records.description: Unmanned Systems Group focuses on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) solutions for agriculture, featuring Supercam unmanned aircraft systems. These UAVs specialize in precise monitoring of plant life and control over agricultural operations. Key features of these UAVs include encrypted data transmission, a variety of payloads, and an easy-to-use control interface. The initiative is essential in agriculture, supporting tasks such as horizontal and cartographic control surveys, monitoring vegetation health, and overseeing technological operations. The UAVs generate georeferenced Orthomosaic and digital elevation models, enabling accurate field mapping. They use multispectral cameras to observe crop conditions, employing various vegetation indices for detailed analysis.

The technology supports various agricultural tasks, from monitoring crop health to optimizing resource usage. The positive impacts can include enhanced agricultural management, resource efficiency, and the uptake of more environmentally friendly farming practices.

records.title: Smartsoil
records.description: The Smartsoil is a set of digital farming solutions, offering a range of products including humidity sensors, irrigation automation, multispectral sensors, climate stations, and an analysis platform. Data from the climate stations are timely accessible via a mobile application. Smartsoil employs soil moisture sensors to offer precise irrigation insights, monitoring root activity and optimizing water use. The irrigation systems ensure intelligent irrigation and fertilization, enhancing plant health and resource efficiency. Multi-spectral sensors enable aerial analysis for crop health assessment. Climate stations provide real-time weather and soil data, aiding strategic decision-making. The Aerobotics platform delivers tree data via drone technology, optimizing production and predicting harvests.
records.abstract: Sensors, climate stations and mobile app for farm irrigation and fertilization management

_annotations.Impact: The Smartsoil’s moisture sensors offer precise insights into root activity and water absorption, resulting in optimized irrigation, water conservation, and increased productivity. Smart irrigation can enhance plant health and can lead to resource efficiency, reducing electricity and water consumption. Integration of multispectral sensors and drones in field analysis provides farmers with detailed crop health data, enabling early disease detection and informed decision-making. Climate stations provide their real-time weather and soil data, contributing to efficient farm management and strategic planning. For smallholder farmers, these technologies offer cost-saving benefits and can possibly increase their resilience to resource constraints. The Aerobotics platform's tree health monitoring and harvest predictions can empower farmers to make timely interventions, ensuring optimal yields. Collectively, Smartsoil's solutions promote sustainability by reducing water and energy usage, minimizing environmental impact, and fostering precision agriculture.

records.title: SMS Vaga
records.description: SMS Vaga is an electronic scale designed for measuring honey yields. It also provides real-time data on the weather conditions in the apiary and safeguards the apiary, hives, or vehicle from theft by offering the GPS position of the hive. The device monitors its own battery status, notifies of potential overload, reports the current balance of the SIM used for sending SMS messages, and ensures protection against theft by requiring information provided exclusively to the buyer for operation. It can share reports including information about daily nectar intake, water removal during the night, number of workers in the control hive and approximate daily yield.
records.abstract: Electronic device to measure honey yields

_annotations.Impact: SMS Vaga promptly provides crucial information on key parameters essential for effective apiary management, facilitating informed decision-making. The remote data collection feature can enable beekeepers to minimize visits to the apiaries. Additionally, it can serve as a theft deterrent for the apiary, vehicle, or hives by offering the GPS position of the device and preventing unauthorized users from accessing the solution without permission.

records.title: Farmer’s Portal (Portali i Fermerit)
records.description: The Farmer’s Portal (Portali i Fermerit) is a digital platform designed to help farmers as it offers daily updated information and services related to agriculture, aquaculture, food, and rural development. The platform provides news, analyses and information on financial support, production, daily food prices, and opportunities in fisheries, aquaculture, and land rental as well as information about more than 260 agritourism units (December 2023) guesthouses, ecoparks and camping spots offered by the agritourism sector in the country. Prices of agricultural products are published with the source of wholesale markets and collection points based on transactions between private entities. The Farmer’s Portal addresses the problem of the information gap in market prices and empowers farmers to make informed decisions while ensuring that price information is available to all food consumers. Farmers can also contact specialists for more information.

The platform facilitates decision-making on the value chain actors in the country giving visibility to the agriculture realities.

records.title: Porphyrio
records.description: Porphyrio is a comprehensive digital solution for the poultry farming industry, designed to streamline various aspects of poultry production, such as farm management tasks, health monitoring and performance optimization. Functioning as a digital platform accessible through desktop or web-based applications, it integrates advanced data analytics to monitor and manage various aspects of poultry production. Porphyrio is a modular solution, with each module offering distinct features. Key functionalities: The solution encompasses features for efficient farm management, including scheduling, resource allocation, and decision-making based on real-time data for health management. Aiding in the early detection of diseases or irregularities and providing recommendations for appropriate interventions among others. Porphyrio aims to optimize overall performance by enhancing feed efficiency, maximizing egg production, and improving the productivity of poultry farming operations.
records.abstract: Advanced data analytics based on IoTs for poultry farming

_annotations.Impact: Porphyrio’s mission is to revolutionize the poultry farming industry through advanced data analytics and monitoring technologies. It provides real-time insights into key performance indicators, allowing informed decision-making to optimize feed efficiency and streamline production processes. Farmers can leverage data-driven insights to improve outcomes in areas like egg production, while predictive analytics empower proactive decision-making by anticipating trends and challenges. Porphyrio also assists in resource management, allowing farmers to monitor and adjust resources consumption for optimal utilization. Overall, the platform's data-driven approach has the potential to maximize productivity and enhance farm management.

records.title: Sentek
records.description: Sentek Sensor Technologies is an international company delivering technologies to measure and understand soil moisture, temperature and salinity data time series. Sentek’s technologies can be used to monitor groundwater movement, generate research data and gain insights into crop water usage to make better irrigation decisions. The company obtained the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001 certification.
records.abstract: Sensor technologies for measuring and managing soil moisture, salinity and temperature

_annotations.Impact: Growers can use Sentek technologies to save on water input costs, reduce waste, increase crop yield and quality and ensure long-term sustainability. The insights can be used to identify yearly patterns, and make accurate forecasts about crop, soil and salinity management to fine-tune dryland and irrigation farm management practices. The solution is meant to collect and show data to enhance soil management decisions. Particularly, some case studies highlighted how the use of ​ ​Sentek monitoring allowed drip irrigation  to reach a depth of no more than 40-50cm, (the root zone) rather than a depth of 90cm as done before the introduction of Sentek. Watering durations were also reduced from 6 to 3 hours, halving the amount of water applied, while still maintaining average productivity.

records.title: Momxmarebeli.ge
records.description: Momxmarebeli.ge is a website supported by the Center for Strategic Studies and Development of Georgia to share information about food safety audits and protecting consumer rights. The website educates consumers on food rights, producer obligations, and reports on products that might not be in line with appropriate standards or could even harm consumers. The platform serves as a hub for legal consultations, legislative updates, and media support, ensuring a well-rounded approach.
records.abstract: Food safety audits and consumer protection website
records.owner_name: Center for Strategic Studies and Development of Georgia

_annotations.Impact: Momxmarebeli.ge is expected to make a positive impact in Georgia by helping people know their rights as consumers. The website checks and tests various products, making sure they are safe. This may lead to better-quality products in the market. Producers may become more responsible for the quality of the production process and small farmers may benefit by learning about market rules and making better products. Overall, Momxmarebeli.ge aims to empower consumers, improve product safety, and create a network for better consumer protection in Georgia. According to the site statistics, 568 products have been tested, 87 violations have been identified, 362 complaints have been received, 1189 consultations have been made, and over 3.5 millions visits have been reported since 2017.

records.title: Nahil
records.description: Nahil is a social enterprise that uses an e-commerce platform to market and sell handmade, nature-friendly, specially designed products, including second-hand products, produced by women's cooperatives and individual women producers from all over Turkey. Nahil collaborates with individual producers and women's cooperatives engaged in the production of marketable goods, offering them access to an e-commerce platform through which they can effectively market and sell their products.
records.abstract: E-commerce platform for women-made products

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: Nahıl website reports that the e-commerce platform contributes to the economic empowerment of low-income women as it enables women to earn income by bringing handmade products and local durable food products produced to the national and international markets. Further, it reportedly improves the quality of women's products. The social enterprise also provides design support to women producers. Nahıl aims to be a permanent market for women, a starting point for participation in economic life, and an education and communication space to develop products for the market. The website states that the income obtained from Nahıl is used to meet the needs of women and children's centers run by women's cooperatives in poor neighborhoods.

records.title: OpTIS
records.description: The Operational Tillage Information System (OpTIS) enables agriculture community to annually measure adoption of soil health practices in a standardized, systematic, and cost-efficient way across large-scale geographies. OpTIS is an automated system to map tillage, residue cover, winter cover, and soil health practices using remote sensing data. OpTIS enables tracking progress against sustainability goals, allowing for the identification of field-level trends. This information serves to optimize farm management decisions, ensuring a more sustainable and environmentally friendly approach to agriculture.
records.abstract: Operational Tillage Information System

_annotations.Impact: Among the impacts reported by the Nature Conservancy, OpTIS can help manage soil and water conservation districts establish priorities and evaluate progress in achieving county or statewide goals. Furthermore, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and state governments used OpTIS to track progress towards and better focus efforts to meet the ambitious goals of the Gulf of Mexico Hypoxia Task Force to reduce harmful nutrient (primarily nitrogen and phosphorus) loading in the Mississippi River basin. Stakeholders throughout the agri-food system supply chain can better understand market trends in the adoption of cover crops and specific tillage systems that impact environmental sustainability, such as greenhouse gas emissions and soil carbon sequestration. Regional and national agricultural offices evaluate and compare the effectiveness of conservation programs across large regions. Overall, OpTIS can facilitate the adoption of regenerative agriculture practices, which are designed to enhance soil health, biodiversity, and ecosystem resilience. By optimizing farming techniques based on data-driven insights, Regrow contributes to reducing the environmental footprint of agricultural activities. The platform's use of advanced models like the DNDC model allows farmers to assess and mitigate the impact of their activities on greenhouse gas emissions, particularly nitrogen compounds. This contributes to climate change mitigation efforts by promoting sustainable land management practices. Farms adopting OpTIS benefit from enhanced operational efficiency. The platform provides insights into field-level trends, enabling farmers to make informed decisions about crop management, tillage practices, and cover crop adoption. This, in turn, can lead to increased productivity and reduced waste. By focusing on regenerative agriculture principles, Regrow supports practices that promote long-term soil health. This includes minimizing soil erosion, improving nutrient cycling, and fostering a healthier soil microbiome.

records.title: Meteotrek
records.description: Meteotrek is a weather monitoring solution integrating weather stations and advanced software for agricultural optimization. Key features include real-time weather data, forecasts, and historical analyses. This technology can be used to continuously monitor the weather from the field and plan operations accordingly. The data from the weather stations are made available in the form of Meteotrek API and can be added to any weather analytics and business software.
records.abstract: Software integrating weather stations for agricultural optimization

_annotations.Impact: Meteotrek can impact Ukrainian agriculture in various ways. More than 450 stations with public access are installed in Ukraine, covering more than 500 000 hectares. Reliable and sound services are provided thanks to 29 weather forecast models based on this network of local weather stations and more than 18 years of experience in the agri-tech field. According to the company’s website, farmers and agricultural actors can make smarter decisions with real-time weather data, leading to improved productivity and resource efficiency. Meteotrek's accessibility, especially through mobile apps, ensures that even small farmers can leverage advanced weather information for better agricultural practices.

records.title: Kalo.ge
records.description: Kalo.ge is a multifunctional agricultural platform in Georgia, offering a range of digital services, including an online marketplace, soil analysis, personalized farm management, agricultural advice, knowledge material and financial services. Kalo.ge serves as an agroportal, providing a comprehensive suite of services, among which are Agromarket that connects buyers and sellers, facilitating transactions in agricultural products, equipment, and service; AgroMeter, a soil analysis solution including soil testing with scanning technologies; and personalized farm management tools. It also provides premium offerings such as Agro Adviser on a Visit, i.e. agronomist consultations at users' farms, combining in-person visits with instant online advice. Collaborating with Credo Bank, Kalo.ge also integrates financial services, offering preferential rates to users.
records.abstract: Multifunctional platform and shop for farmers

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: Kalo.ge has potential to boost farmer productivity through personalized tools and efficient management. Financial collaboration with Credo Bank aims to provide preferential rates for economic empowerment. Real-time weather forecasts, soil analysis and expert consultations aid informed decision-making. The Video Library promotes continuous learning. The Agro Adviser service offers comprehensive support, and a blended model ensures user engagement. Efforts in digital literacy can positively influence rural communities.

records.title: ImeceMobil
records.description: ImeceMobil is a web platform and mobile application that allows users to access free-of charge digital tools, information and services. Some examples are precise location-specific weather forecasts, agrometeorological notifications, farm advisory services from experts, agricultural news, stock market prices, transactions and market information through innovative and high-quality services. Among its services, Imecemobil provides satellite supported irrigation services and fertilization suggestion services; expert supported satellite service serves to monitor plant health; imecestory is a service offered to help farmers to tell their story and also direct selling; imecebilar use satellite technologies to detect planning areas and identity plant patterns; imecemeteo provides innovative weather data services by combing satellite and expert human knowledge.
records.abstract: Suite of digital agricultural tools and services

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The services of ImeceMobil strive to help farmers manage their production in a data-driven way while promoting the sustainability of agriculture and reducing the cost of inputs such as water, fertilizer, medicine and energy and finally increasing efficiency and use the country's resources effectively. Up to January 2024, 183 thousand users were registered in the online platform, covering a crop production area of 78 thousand hectares, 10 000 animal production units and 50 million notifications sent.

records.title: Green Day Organic Store
records.description: Green Day Organic Store is an e-commerce platform for sustainable living and production in Armenia, offering a diverse range of organic products, as well as a physical shop. The store supports environmental well-being, providing customers with ethically sourced goods. Key features include a selection of organic foods, locally and seasonally produced, eco-friendly household items, and cruelty-free beauty products. The store tries to promote a healthier lifestyle by prioritizing products free from harmful chemicals. Users can add products to their cart and get them delivered to their address in Armenia.
records.abstract: Organic e-marketplace

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The overall impact of the Green Day Organic Store is about trying to foster a culture of conscious consumerism and support the livelihoods of local farmers. Particularly, the platform supports local farmers by serving as an ethically responsive marketplace, enhancing their visibility and potentially increasing their income. By offering a diverse range of ethical products, Green Day also tries to contribute to individual health and well-being, and to facilitate exchange of sustainable practices. Furthermore, by prioritizing eco-friendly products, Green Day encourages sustainable practices, fostering a sense of community and shared values among individuals committed to  ethical and organic products consumption.

records.title: Fermer.KG
records.description: Fermer.KG is an online marketplace that enables farmers to sell agri-food products online. Key features include nationwide coverage, livestock and vegetable market inclusion, and real-time market prices accessible via a user-friendly mobile app. The platform facilitates exports, providing data-driven insights and educational materials. On the basis of Fermer KG, educational and video materials for the effective cultivation of crops and livestock, including pedigree livestock, as well as many useful materials for the successful introduction of agricultural activities, are collected and constantly updated. Video reviews of markets allow for assessing the situation in large markets of the country, and statistics, in turn, provide price guidelines for all market participants. Fermer.KG compiles and consistently updates educational and video resources aimed at enhancing crop and livestock farming. Its distinctive traits lie in connecting rural communities, promoting sustainable practices, and offering virtual market overviews.

_annotations.Impact: The platform aims to facilitate convenient and independent sales, promote local and global trade opportunities, and contribute to productivity improvement through real-time statistics. Additionally, it aspires to empower farmers through educational materials.

records.title: Earthdaily Geosys
records.description: The Geosys platform is a cloud-based platform that provides the critical capabilities such as data or API needed throughout the analytic process of data-driven farm decisions. The modules available in this cloud-based platform include from data connectivity to the data preparation and enrichment needed to create analytics-ready data, to advanced analytics and modelling, to flexible delivery options that provide reporting, visualization, and collaboration. Current API includes field vegetation index maps to measure vegetation time series and growth measured daily. These indexes are NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), EVI (Enhanced Vegetation Index), CVI (Chlorophyll Vegetation Index), GNDVI (Green Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), LAI (Leaf Area Index) and more if needed. Furthermore, the platform offers field agronomy maps such as yield variability and yield goal map, organic matter map, satellite derived management zones, elevation and slopes map, nitrogen application maps (for wheat, barley, canola and more). Another API offered by geosys platform concerns weather data. These collect and display multi-model datasets covering historical, current weather and forecasts, several aggregation levels: admin unit, small ag region and location based agronomic parameters like temp min, max, average, rainfall, wind speed, humidity, snow depth, atmospheric pressure, soil moisture, temperature and precipitation (Daily). Finally, the platform is equipped with API for notifications and warnings to get information as soon as available on the Geosys platform and focus on key information or anomalies. Among these, users can receive new satellite image notification, difference map with anomaly detection, fields benchmarking and status change. Overall, geosys addresses challenges in agriculture, enhancing resilience by delivering analytics that reduce everyday risks, making it a transformative solution for precision farming.
records.abstract: Advanced analytics based on satellite imagery and machine learning

_annotations.Impact: The Geosys platform can yield tangible positive outcomes across diverse sectors. In agriculture, it aims to enable precise resource allocation, enhancing operational efficiency for farmers and enterprises. The platform's analytics, including NDVI and Yield Trend Benchmarking, can contribute to improved decision-making throughout the growing season, resulting in optimized yields. In the FinTech industry, the platform's risk assessment tools, such as Productivity Risk Score Maps, can lead to more accurate underwriting and fair market pricing. This can have a direct impact on operational efficiency and cash flow management, streamlining processes for financial institutions. In commodities trading and logistics, the Geosys platform can empower decision-makers with a comprehensive understanding of global crop conditions, as well as monitor and benchmark fields and optimize inputs. This insight can facilitate more informed decisions on supply chain management, leading to increased profitability and streamlined operations. For the food and beverage industry, the platform's invisible weather insights derived from satellite imagery can contribute to better harvest planning, enabling stakeholders to anticipate changes in crop yields and improving overall production efficiency and quality.

records.title: Farmer.ba
records.description: Farmer.ba is an e-commerce platform dedicated to showcasing and distributing a diverse array of high-quality products sourced directly from local farmers. It is also a space where users can find information about healthy and natural food and order it directly from local farmers. Farmer.ba is the first service in Bosnia and Herzegovina that enables detailed insight and overview of local food producers and in an innovative way promotes agriculture and also provides opportunities for cooperation and partnerships. The e-commerce platform specifically caters to the needs of farmers engaged in cultivation, alleviating the challenges they face in finding time to market their products.
records.abstract: E-commerce platform created for local farmers

_annotations.Impact: As of May 2024, Farmers.ba hosts 150 farmers and presents about 600 different products from 45 individual shops. The e-commerce platform has resulted in tangible and positive outcomes, contributing to various aspects of the local community and agricultural sector in Bosnia and Herzegovina, according to the company’s website. One of the key impacts is the direct support provided to local farmers to showcase and distribute their products. This enhances their market visibility and enables them to connect with a broader customer base. Farmer.ba promotes food choices, by providing users with information about locally sourced products, to encourage healthier eating habits and foster a sense of community engagement around sustainable and locally produced food. The platform eases and allows the farmers to focus on farming while ensuring their products reach a wider audience through the e-commerce platform.

records.title: Fermerlar Maktabi
records.description: The School of Farmers (Fermerlar Matkabi) is a web platform that focuses on imparting knowledge of cutting-edge technologies for agricultural production to young individuals. Key features include an emphasis on educating and qualifying young farmers, equipping them with the skills necessary for modern agricultural practices. Training courses are provided in livestock breeding, poultry farming, greenhouse farming, vegetable and fruit growing, or viticulture.
records.abstract: Online training school for farmers

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The website is the technology which is part of the broader offer of School of Farmers to teach new farmers and learn from highly qualified teachers with international experience in the agricultural field. The website promotes a combination of theoretical and practical training, master classes by leading business owners in the field, opportunity to expand the network of business partners, and a certificate of eligibility for a preferential loan. The initiative actively contributes to the advancement of technologically sophisticated farming practices, empowering users to utilize advanced tools for effective management and data-driven decision-making. Its user-centric approach ensures inclusive education, benefiting young farmers. Overall, it aims to generate a positive impact on sustainability and community development in the agricultural sector.

records.title: Farmio
records.description: Farmio App is a web platform and mobile application that allows indoor farmers to remotely monitor and automatically optimize all environmental conditions to improve harvest yields while reducing their workload. Remote monitoring, alerts & notifications, automated control, plant disease diagnosis, and recipe optimization are the main modules and functionalities of this web-based platform connected with sensors and others. Farmio precisely controls the growing conditions of the plants to ensure that the farmers get perfect yield and quality consistently while saving on time and resources. The solution aims to support and assist farmers and growers in the market by improving their efficiency and increasing the quality of their products whilst keeping their costs at an optimal level.
records.abstract: AI-powered platform for monitoring indoor farming conditions

_annotations.Impact: The Farmio App claims to guarantee farmers a consistent and high-quality yield while optimizing their use of time and resources. According to the company’s website, this technology contributes to producing up to 50 percent more crops yearly; consume up to 40 percent fewer resources; achieve high quality with every harvest; and spend up to 60 percent less time on daily tasks. The solution aims at serving as support for farmers and growers in the market, enhancing their overall efficiency. By utilizing Farmio, farmers could elevate the quality of their products, all while maintaining optimal costs and resource utilization. This could not only ensure a successful harvest, but it could also contribute to the sustainable and efficient growth of agricultural practices.

records.title: Earth Map
records.description: The Earth Map is a web platform, facilitated by technical cooperation and support from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), that serves as a resource to inform about agricultural policies at the national level and adapt local agricultural production strategies to the challenges posed by climate change. The platform ensures widespread access to spatial data, catering to various stakeholders such as institutions, farmers, scientists, and the general public. Its distinctive trait lies in fostering collaboration and knowledge-sharing among diverse groups, promoting a holistic approach to data-driven decision-making in agriculture. The benefits are multifaceted, including improved national and local-level agricultural planning, enhanced resilience to climate change impacts, and informed policymaking.
records.abstract: Platform featuring spatial data
records.owner_name: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry, and Water Economy

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: The Earth Map initiative in North Macedonia fosters informed decision-making at national and local levels. It stands as a key player in adapting local agriculture to climate change, promoting resilience in the face of environmental challenges. Policymakers benefit from valuable insights, contributing to the formulation of effective and targeted policies. The initiative's collaborative approach encourages knowledge sharing among stakeholders, creating a more interconnected agricultural community. With widespread access to spatial data, the initiative promotes sustainability and inclusive development in the agricultural sector.

records.title: E-zemjodelst
records.description: The national e-agriculture platform is a tool of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Management of North Macedonia to provide access to the latest information tools for spatial, climatic and market information in the field of agriculture in one place. The platform is composed of different sections: “My Farm” is the section to store and process farm management data; the “Maps” section is to gather and visualize agro-meteorological data; the "Meteor" and "Reports" sections are to make available the most modern spatial tools for accessing geo-location services, including spatially agrometeorological data from the national "Agrometeo" platform. Meanwhile, within the framework of the "Reporting" section, a national tool for "citizen science" is being activated, where the public can directly notify and contribute to the management of pests and other adverse events in agriculture. All institutions, farmers, scientists and the general public have access to national and international spatial data for the country. The platform offers accessibility to essential national digital systems and the goal is to improve data for policy-making and facilitate the transition towards more productive and sustainable agriculture in line with sustainable development goals.

records.title: Dijital Tarım Çözümümü (Digital Agriculture Solution)
records.description: The Digital Agriculture Solution is a web and mobile platform solution that empowers users to precisely measure key agri-environmental parameters of their land such as air temperature, rainfall and soil temperature and support farm decisions. This data helps prevent losses due to climate risks. It is  based on several high precision sensors to be installed on land and it predicts crop diseases, prompting users to take early action. The solution also aids in precise business planning, providing timely insights for planting, harvesting, and more. Accessible via web and mobile, it enables real-time monitoring, with instant notifications for critical conditions. It's a comprehensive tool for informed decision-making, risk management, and maximizing agricultural productivity.
records.abstract: Agro-meteorological decision support platform

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: Vodafone reports that the Digital Agriculture Solution ensures a significant increase in harvest efficiency, resulting in higher-quality crops. Users also benefit from substantial resource cost reductions, including up to a 40 percent decrease in water usage, a 40 percent reduction in electricity consumption, and up to 30 percent cost savings on pesticides and fertilizers. These concrete outcomes underscore the solution's effectiveness in improving crop quality and promoting sustainable and cost-effective farming practices.

records.title: Digital business management tool integrated in a large agricultural enterprise "Agricom Group"
records.description: Besides being a large enterprise producing and commercializing staple food cultivated on Ukrainian fields, Agricom Group pays great attention to the innovations and investments into the development of modern digital-projects. records.title: Cropwise
records.description: Cropwise is a platform that integrates multiple interoperable services and solutions for planting, pest and nutrient management, insurance, and farm operations. Among the services is “Commodity Pro”, a service to buy crop protection and seed products protecting the farmers from the volatility of the market. Commodities can be bought in advance and if the price decreases over time the company provides up to 15 percent to 20 percent cash back. Another service “Imagery” utilizes satellite data, offers a bird's eye view, facilitating crop health monitoring. “Operations” is a monitoring solution providing information to identify areas with problems and recommending use of resources. It includes satellite images of fields, image history dating back to 2013, automatic alerts if the vegetation index goes down, NDVI images also in cloudy weather. It can be used to plan operations, record filed activities from seeding to harvesting, automatically record connected machine tasks, monitor operations in real-time. “Planting” is a solution leveraging satellite images, yield maps and manually draw or edit zones to optimize the use of seeds and fertilisers with variable rate technology, create variable rate scripts for seeds and fertilisers, download and use script in the machinery.  “Protector” integrates digital monitoring for pests, diseases, and crop health. It tracks farm activities such as applications, quality and productivity indicators, free notes, infestation levels, audio and/or photos of the crops. “Seed Selector” service supports decision making providing seed recommendations for maximum yields. “Spray Assist” provides recommendations on the best time to go spraying and how to optimise the equipment set up, based on weather risks in the region. “Sustainability”, aligned with Gold FSA standards, is a tool to calculate farm-level sustainability score and, by enabling sharing results and insights, to assess operation's leadership/management compared to other farmers.
records.abstract: Modular agricultural solution for farm management

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: Cropwise aims to foster increased yields through precision agriculture, leveraging modules like Seed Selector and Planting. Commodity Pro aims to mitigate financial risks, providing cashback during price volatility. The Sustainability module is designed to promote and measure sustainable farming practices, contributing to environmentally conscious agriculture. Spray Assist aims to optimize crop protection, minimizing environmental impact. Imagery is intended to empower farmers with efficient crop monitoring, leading to timely interventions. Protector's digital monitoring aims to aid in proactive pest and disease management. Operations are intended to streamline farm management, reducing operational costs. Collectively, Cropwise tries to promote economic resilience, sustainable practices, and increased productivity in modern agriculture. The digital platform can support multiple crops, farm sizes, and operations, covering 230 million acres and serving 40 000 users.

records.title: CALCILM2
records.description: The “Integrated Natural Resource Management in Drought-Prone and Saline Agricultural Production Landscapes of Central Asia and Turkey” (CACILM-2) project implemented by Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and Global Environment Facility (GEF) in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Centre of Hydrometeorological Service of the Republic of Uzbekistan aimed at enhancing data-driven farming decisions based on agrometeorological observations in Uzbekistan. In 2020, FAO transferred 12 modern automatic agrometeorological stations to Centre of Hydrometeorological Service, which were installed in the agricultural territories of Jizzakh and Kashkadarya regions. Training sessions have been organized for regional hydrometeorology specialists to ensure effective utilization of the new stations.
records.abstract: Integrated Natural Resources Management in Drought-prone and Salt-affected Agricultural Production Landscapes in Central Asia and Turkey
records.owner_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

_annotations.Impact: The implementation of automatic agrometeorological stations in Uzbekistan is expected to yield concrete positive outcomes and impacts. Farmers, particularly smallholders, stand to benefit from timely and accurate weather and climate information. The stations enable proactive decision-making in daily operations and long-term planning, leading to enhanced agricultural practices. This empowerment is anticipated to reduce risks associated with crop yields, improve resource utilization (such as pesticides), and contribute to sustainable farming. Additionally, the initiative aligns with broader goals of integrated natural resource management and supports the UN Convention to Combat Desertification and the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change in the Central Asian region. Overall, the positive outcomes include increased resilience in the agricultural sector, improved livelihoods for farmers, and progress toward environmental sustainability.

records.title: BeeCare
records.description: BeeCare is a digital service designed to aid beekeepers in remotely managing and monitoring their hives. It offers real-time data on factors like temperature, weight, and humidity, optimizing hive conditions for enhanced honey production. This information is easily accessible through a dedicated mobile app. Additionally, BeeCare provides SMS Scale, a digital solution delivering hive weight, temperature, and humidity details via SMS to mobile phones. To prevent apiary theft, BeeCare offers a GPS tracking system, ensuring beekeepers can safeguard their hives effectively.
records.abstract: Digital hives monitoring

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: BeeCare is a system designed to significantly improve operational efficiency for beekeepers by offering real-time data on hive conditions, including temperature, weight, and humidity. This allows for timely and informed decision-making, optimizing hive management practices. The system's wireless connectivity and mobile app can contribute to time and cost savings, reducing the need for frequent physical inspections. Beekeepers can remotely access crucial information, enhancing their ability to plan and organize tasks effectively. BeeCare's technology promotes sustainable beekeeping practices by minimizing unnecessary hive disturbances and providing precise environmental data. It can aid in the protection and well-being of bee colonies. This aligns with broader environmental and ecological goals, contributing to the preservation of bee populations and biodiversity.

records.title: Biosens
records.description: Biosens is a Serbian research institute offering a number of digital solutions, such as a tool for early prediction of wheat yield based on artificial intelligence, a robotic system and method for intelligent soil sampling, and multifunctional and innovative platform SmartAgro for agricultural insurance management, which allows easy management of claims and policies via both web and mobile application. Focused on precision agriculture, platform's approach optimizes farming practices, aiming to reduce input costs and enhance crop yield sustainably. The institute offers numerous environmental monitoring technologies for sustainable resource management, measuring air and water quality and biodiversity. The institute's key features include a commitment to technological innovation, evident in the development of cutting-edge sensors and data analysis techniques. Farmers can benefit from solutions that increase efficiency and crop quality. The institute provides services in sensing technologies, information technologies (including the use of satellite data) and biosystems. It also creates and manages products such as a device to assess the wellbeing of plants (Plan-O-Meter) or for early detection of mastitis in dairy cattle (FastMast).
records.abstract: Precision farming technologies for industry and government actors

_annotations.Impact: The Biosens Institute reports that their precision farming technologies can optimize resource use, slashing input costs while boosting crop yields. Real-time soil monitoring can ensure efficient irrigation and fertilization, fostering sustainable practices. Environmental monitoring, facilitated by BioSense's sensor networks, can empower conservation efforts. Accurate data on air and water quality, as well as biodiversity, can aid informed decision-making, contributing to sustainable resource management. Customized applications can address varied agricultural, environmental, and healthcare needs. The Biosens Institute's solutions are expected to drive positive change, fostering sustainability and conservation.

records.title: AssistAgro
records.description: AssistAgro is a digital platform for effective management of weed and plant diseases in crops. It leverages advanced technologies such as drones, remote sensing, and artificial intelligence for precision agriculture. It enhances weed detection through drones, calculates crop density and optimizes herbicide use, significantly boosting production efficiency. GEOMIR AssistAgro stands out with automatic flight routes, smooth data integration, and a user-friendly app for agronomists. It aims to boost production, cut herbicide use, and guide farmers with smart decisions. AssistAgro, among other capabilities, is meant to facilitate farmers in solving the following problems: - forecast of the appearance and development of weeds; - calculation of the density of the condition and quality of the arrangement of crop plants; - forecast of the appearance and development of diseases of agricultural plants.
records.abstract: Drone-based platform for automatic field scouting and crop farming decision support

_annotations.Impact: As of December 2023, ​ ​AssistAgro reports that the platform delivers substantial benefits to crop farming, including a notable 20 percent reduction in herbicide consumption, leading to significant cost savings for farmers. By optimizing herbicide use, the solution increases overall agricultural efficiency, resulting in a potential 10 percent boost in productivity. Additionally, its precision agriculture features, powered by drone technology and AI analytics, contribute to informed decision-making, reducing the risk of crop losses. Overall, the platform strives to increase yield, optimization of herbicide rates and control sowing density.

records.title: AKIS Agro
records.description: AKIS is a web platform supporting Uzbekistan's Agricultural Knowledge and Information System to showcase services focusing on agricultural knowledge and innovation systems in Uzbekistan and promote innovative changes by fostering collaboration among public, private, and organizational stakeholders by highlighting scientific knowledge, training and available services, such as laboratory services, access to irrigation subsidies, equipment testing, land allotment, digital mapping, drone services, and regulatory compliance support, underscoring its commitment to holistic agricultural development in Uzbekistan. The content and resources of the AKIS platform are organized into categories so that the promoted services can be searched by popularity or by organization/supplier. Through the platform, users can access generic information about any specific service such as the name of the organization promoting it, the type of users accessing the service, the duration of the service, its legal basis, any available contact and its price. The application works also as a repository of documents including laws, decrees of the President, Government decisions and orders, and regulatory documents from the Ministry of Justice. An embedded calendar also allows the sharing of events related to agricultural matters in the country. An interactive map also shows the number of services and other basic statistics per region that are included in the platform.

records.title: Application of real-time satellite monitoring and weather data analysis for crop management at "Naydorovskoe LLP" farm
records.description: Naydorovskoe LLP in Kazakhstan is a farm that expanded from 200 hectares to 20 000 hectares in over 20 years, and has embraced digital agriculture since 2016, employing solutions like Cropio and a METOS weather station. This initiative simplifies crop management through real-time satellite monitoring and weather data analysis. Farmers can monitor the state of vegetation without going into the field or reducing the visits to carry out validation checks with or without the agronomist. Key benefits include informed decision-making for sowing, harvesting, and irrigation, enhancing productivity and resource efficiency. Challenges addressed include overwatering, leading to improved crop quality and increased potato yield.

_annotations.Impact: Naydorovskoe LLP makes use of digital technologies to achieve a substantial rise in potato yield, 43-45 tons per hectare. The initiative is expected to address water concerns and enhance produce quality by implementing precise irrigation planning, however, with the expansion of plant pots for irrigated crops and the objective of increasing yields, the amount of total water used increased. Real-time data from Cropio and METOS weather station is anticipated to empower informed decision-making for more efficient farm management, yet the overall quantity of water used has increased in the context of water scarcity in Kazakhstan. The initiative aims to preserve resources and introduce in-demand crops, thereby diversifying crop rotation. In summary, Naydorovskoe LLP's digital agriculture initiative is expected to positively impact productivity, resource management, and economic sustainability.

records.title: Aragil
records.description: Aragil integrates technologies like drones and satellite data to transform farming practices. Through real-time aerial monitoring, Aragil offers precise field mapping, 3D modeling, and vegetation index calculations, empowering farmers with actionable insights for enhanced crop management. Leveraging GIS, GPS, and advanced analytics, the initiative addresses challenges in agriculture, providing solutions for efficient land use, crop health monitoring, and yield forecasting. Particularly, Aragil uses aerial photography by drones in both visible and thermal environments to get up-to-date information whenever it is necessary, to draw electronic maps of the fields, as well as 3D models, carry out monitoring of lands, crops, harvest and irrigation systems, calculate the vegetation index, forecast the crop yield, find erosive, dry or wet soils, control the quality of work during harvest gathering.
records.abstract: Aerial photography with drones

_annotations.Impact: By enabling real-time aerial monitoring and precise mapping, Aragil’s solution facilitates informed decision-making for farmers. This can potentially lead to enhanced crop management practices, improved pest control, and optimized resource utilization, contributing to increased agricultural productivity. The utilization of the NDVI vegetation index for crop health monitoring and yield forecasting may bring more resilient and sustainable farming practices. This data-driven approach aims at not only aiding precision farming but also supporting environmental conservation by reducing unnecessary resource use. The solution could empower smaller farmers with tools traditionally reserved for larger enterprises, fostering a more equitable distribution of technological benefits within the agricultural sector.

records.title: Agroskills
records.description: Agroskills is a web platform developed by the Georgian Farmers’ Association with the support of the European Union that allows users to find audio-visual material and learn about agronomy and boost their skills in agriculture. Educational content is available in both Georgian and English language. Key features include a diverse range of agricultural training programs, workshops, and resources tailored to enhance skills and knowledge. The platform involves a focus on practical learning, bridging the gap between theory and on-field applications. Benefits encompass empowering individuals within the agriculture sector with valuable expertise, ultimately bolstering the industry. Innovative elements include the utilization of modern teaching methodologies, incorporating technology to provide accessible and interactive learning experiences. Agroskills addresses challenges in the agriculture sector by equipping participants with practical skills to navigate evolving industry demands. records.title: AgroTimeAL
records.description: AgroTimeAL is a web and mobile phone application designed to allow users to offer, search, access and explore agritourism experiences in Albania, organized into three primary categories: certified agritourism farms, tourist farms, and taste routes. The agritourism establishments featured in this app update their information, spotlighting traditions, histories, and local cuisines by meeting three key criteria: providing accommodation, serving traditional regional dishes, and offering engaging farm activities. AgroTimeAL addresses a significant challenge in Albanian tourism – the scarcity of updated, complete, and reliable information. On one side, the application serves as a catalyst for promoting the diverse businesses that are part of its network, on the other side it seeks to broaden its service spectrum across the entire country.
records.abstract: Mobile and web app for agrotourism
records.owner_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development

_annotations.Impact: AgroTimeAl’s possible impacts concern promoting local economies, cultural preservation, tourism experiences, community engagement, environmental awareness, and the overall growth and enrichment of agritourism in Albania. The application aims at bridging information gaps between farms and visitors, facilitating access to details of agritourism experiences across the country, and establishing connections between farms and rural communities, providing visibility for their services and creating avenues for additional revenue streams. By serving as a centralized platform, the application enhances the visitor experience and supports local enterprises in expanding their reach and impact, contributing to the objectives of the Ministry of Agriculture. The application aims at promoting positive changes by fostering collaboration and synergy between agritourism businesses, visitors, and governmental bodies, with the objective of creating a robust and sustainable agricultural landscape in Albania.

records.title: Agromonitor
records.description: AgroMonitor is an online platform that offers software tools necessary for analyzing climate, pedological, spatial and organizational data, as well as tools for self-gathering, storing and presenting data through interactive maps, tables and charts that are easy to interpret and further analyse. The online platform enables advisors and farmers to have easy access to information about agro-ecological and weather conditions, access disease and pest forecasts, and precisely plan fertilization programs for over 100 crops.  AgroMonitor provides detailed information on a diverse range of crops, encompassing stone fruits, brassicas, legumes, and various plant families such as Asteraceae, Solanaceae, Pome, Onions, Grapevine and Apiaceae. It informs farmers about the optimal use of plant production products, including fungicides, and predicts the occurrence of diseases such as Apple Scab, Potato Blight, Grapevine Downy Mildew, Downy Mildew, Late Blight of Celery, and Cucurbit Downy Mildew. Additionally, AgroMonitor advises on the use of plant protection products like insecticides, predicting occurrences of pests such as Codling Moth, Plum Sawfly, Cabbage maggot, Carrot rust fly, and European tarnished plant bug.  The plant fertilization program involves selecting the crop, inputting field details, and planning the fertilization strategy based on expected yield and field characteristics.  AgroMonitor offers software tools necessary for analyzing climate, pedological, spatial and organizational data, as well as tools for self-gathering, storing and presenting data through interactive maps, tables and charts that are easy to interpret and further analyze.

records.title: Agromap
records.description: Agromap is an electronic map of the agricultural system of Dedofliskaro Municipalityi in the form of an online platform. The purpose of the map is to collect contacts and complete information about the participants of the ecosystem of agriculture and food industry to provide it to interested parties. The mapped actors concern processors, associations, education, farms, demo plots, agritourism, collection-distributors, savers, farm shops, nursery, advisory, zoo/vet service, state, agronomist, laboratory, projects, mechanization, finances, open market, livestock market, grocery store, export, slaughterhouse, packaging materials. As a result, various interested parties can establish connections and make business deals remotely through the electronic agro map. Thus, the agrifood sector is digitized through Agromap. Key features include real-time market data, weather forecasts, and expert guidance, creating a connected network for stakeholders.

records.title: AgroLIFE
records.description: AgroLIFE is an automated agriculture production management software for agronomists and farm owners to optimize planning, organization and management of agricultural activities, with the goal of increasing yields and reducing operational expenses. AgroLIFE features customizable modules for individual business processes, covering aspects like land area, crop data, seeding, harvest, and expenses and providing comprehensive Digital Maps Management through Open Source technology. The system includes modules such as tracking and planning the agriculture processes, maintaining  standards for each operation/process, alarm system warning to any deviation or irregularities also through satellite imagery analysis, tracking of the employees’ working hours and productivity, tracking  the agriculture machinery, monitoring vehicles and implements via advance GPS tracking system, and managing costs and overall resources.
records.abstract: Software application for automated agriculture production

SDGs.value: SDG 8: Decent work and economic growth

_annotations.Impact: GreenSoft, the provider, was founded in 2012 to address the lack of suitable global software for efficient agriculture management. AgroLIFE aims to boosts productivity by optimizing planning and execution, increase yields and lower operational costs. It is intended primarily for agricultural producers providing them with better monitoring and risk management, as well as for local governments allowing them to systemically monitor the use of state-owned land and efficient management of the Field works record. Through Municipal Land Management Digitalization project, farmers and local agriculture departments in 10 cities and municipalities in Serbia and BiH can use the application free of charge, with premium expert support and training.  More than a third are tenants of municipal land, who now use AgroLife to record all their activities and, based on that, receive recommendations from weather stations when it's time to go to the field, fertilize, irrigate and protect against pests, which contributes to the preservation of land quality.

AgroLIFE features customizable modules for individual business processes, covering aspects like land area, crop data, seeding, harvest, and expenses and providing comprehensive Digital Maps Management through Open Source technology. The system includes modules such as tracking and planning the agriculture processes, maintaining  standards for each operation/process, alarm system warning to any deviation or irregularities also through satellite imagery analysis, tracking of the employees’ working hours and productivity, tracking  the agriculture machinery, monitoring vehicles and implements via advance GPS tracking system, and managing costs and overall resources.
_raw.Impact: GreenSoft, the provider, was founded in 2012 to address the lack of suitable global software for efficient agriculture management. AgroLIFE aims to boosts productivity by optimizing planning and execution, increase yields and lower operational costs. It is intended primarily for agricultural producers providing them with better monitoring and risk management, as well as for local governments allowing them to systemically monitor the use of state-owned land and efficient management of the Field works record. Through Municipal Land Management Digitalization project, farmers and local agriculture departments in 10 cities and municipalities in Serbia and BiH can use the application free of charge, with premium expert support and training.  More than a third are tenants of municipal land, who now use AgroLife to record all their activities and, based on that, receive recommendations from weather stations when it's time to go to the field, fertilize, irrigate and protect against pests, which contributes to the preservation of land quality.

records.title: Agrometeo
records.description: Agrometeo is a web platform and app that contain information about the weather that is measured at the agrostations. The app contains different types of information, for agriculture like weather, advice about agriculture, documents, etc. Agrometeo summarises information and decision-support tools for the optimized application of plant protection measures in North Macedonian’s agriculture. It integrates crucial information and decision-support tools to enhance the targeted application of plant protection measures in agriculture. Key features include real-time weather data, disease models, and personalized recommendations, ensuring precision in pest and disease management. Distinctively, the platform tailors insights to specific crops and regions, fostering targeted and efficient use of resources. Its benefits encompass improved yield quality, reduced environmental impact, and optimized resource utilization. The innovative aspect lies in the integration of dynamic data for precise decision-making. Agrometeo addresses challenges in agricultural productivity by providing a streamlined solution for plant protection, ultimately enhancing sustainability and profitability in farming practices.
records.abstract: Web platform for optimized application of plant protection measures

_annotations.Impact: Agrometeo fosters precision farming and boosts crop yields through targeted plant protection measures. The platform's resource-efficient approach minimizes environmental impact and empowers smallholder farmers with accessible, data-driven decision support. Continuous refinement of recommendations using machine learning ensures relevance and adaptability to changing conditions. By promoting economic viability and sustainability, Agrometeo significantly contributes to the advancement of agriculture, bridging the technology gap for both large and small-scale farmers. Overall, its impact spans increased productivity, environmental stewardship, and enhanced economic outcomes in farming practices.

records.title: AgroBaza
records.description: AgroBaza is an e-commerce platform dedicated to the agricultural products of Uzbekistan, designed to assist agro-industrial enterprises in marketing their goods and services. It caters primarily to those involved in the production or delivery of agricultural products, spanning areas such as policing, veterinary medicine, viticulture, animal husbandry, vegetable growing, poultry, fisheries, horticulture, and more. The platform not only provides a marketplace but also offers resources for acquiring theoretical and practical knowledge, facilitating the opening of online shops or direct product exposure on the platform. Its core objective is to support entrepreneurs in the agricultural sector by facilitating online trading of goods, enabling customers to access agricultural products at competitive prices and favorable terms.
